body: The Long Beach Community Investment Company - Special Meeting
agenda_text:
THE LONG BEACH COMMUNITY
  INVESTMENT COMPANY AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, JUNE 11, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  DEFOREST CONFERENCE ROOM, 3RD FLOOR, 4:00 PM

Alejandra Ramirez, Chair  Jasmine Esparza, Director
Eva Melgarejo, Vice Chair  Ruben Minjarez, Director
Hakim Chambers, Director  Elwood Sides, Director
Hilda Delgado, Director

  SPECIAL MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL COMMENTS TO
  MEGGAN.SORENSEN@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-55573  Recommendation to receive and file President’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-55574  Recommendation to approve the minutes for The Long Beach Community
  Investment Company meeting of Wednesday, April 16, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-55575  Recommendation to conduct the second public hearing on the Fiscal Year (FY)
  2025-2026 Action Plan; accept public comment and recommend City Council
  approval. (Citywide)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-55576  Recommendation to approve a loan in the amount of up to $2,000,000 to Linc
  Housing Corporation (Linc) for the acquisition and improvement of 4209 East
  Anaheim Street;

  Authorize the President to negotiate the Affordable Housing Loan Agreement with
  Linc; and

  Authorize the President or designee to negotiate and execute any and all
  documents necessary related to the Loan Agreement.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-55577  Recommendation to adopt The Long Beach Community Investment Company
  proposed Fiscal Year 2025-2026 (FY 26) budget.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  25-55578  Recommendation to receive and file Community Outreach Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  25-55581  Closed Session – Initiation of litigation pursuant to paragraph (4) of subdivision (d)
  of Section 54956.9 of the California Government Code (one matter).

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address The Long Beach Community Investment Company on non-agenda items.
Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 24 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact (562) 570-3807 or (562) 570-6957.
